summary: Meta's FAISS vector-search library released version 1.14.2, adding new indexing and quantization features (SuperKMeans, Metal GPU backend for Apple Silicon, RVV SIMD backend, TurboQuant), pip install support, extensive deserialization hardening, and numerous bug fixes.

practices.reason: SuperKMeans and related SIMD/quantization work give a concrete, reproducible technique teams running FAISS could apply directly to speed up clustering and search on their own stack.
practices.quote: SuperKMeans** — faster k-means via ADSampling + PDX progressive pruning (#5168)

practices.reason: An API rename is a breaking change that teams building on FAISS's training API must schedule code updates for.

name train() with queries to train_with_queries (#4955)
